title: The Leeward Escarpment
author: Orsen Delacroix
blurb: Petra Brightwater, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then a dying prospector trades a map for a promise — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
